comments.body: is there any realistic harm to just copy the out_dir approach and create the dir ourselves?

No realistic harm that I can see, so I switched to that in 51f61e1. A missing `--binaries-dir` always errored before the hook ran, so no working setup can depend on the path being absent. The one difference is that on a clean build the hook now finds an empty directory (so e.g. a plain `mkdir` without `-p` would fail), which it already has to handle on any rebuild. A mistyped path will also leave an empty directory behind, same as `--out-dir`.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
